choice.basis: The chart's plotted production series (blue line) is the evidence for the 2018-2023 trend. At the 2018 x-axis tick, the line aligns with the 3,500 y-axis tick (r2-O1). At the 2023 x-axis tick, the line ends at a vertical position just above the 2,000 y-axis tick (r2-O2). Because higher vertical position on the labeled 'Production' axis encodes greater production, the net change from 3,500 (2018) to ~2,100 (2023) is a decrease. The title 'Increasing Production at Factory F from 2018 to 2023' (r1) conflicts with the plotted data, but the plotted line is the authoritative record of the values, and the decline-named option matches the measured net decrease. Therefore, the route to production decline response is justified.
